description: The skill's dashboard: three metrics in a row, then an explicit two-column Grid of cards (a horizontal bar chart, a table, a sparkline in an accent card).

events.text:
```neoui
<Stack>
  <Stack direction="row">
    <Metric label="Used" value="820 GB" delta="of 896 GB" tone="danger"/>
    <Metric label="Free" value="72 GB" delta="8%" tone="success"/>
    <Metric label="Largest" value="Documents" delta="355 GB"/>
  </Stack>
  <Grid columns={2}>
    <Card title="Where the space goes">
      <BarChart labels={["Documents", ".cache", "Games", "Other"]} horizontal>
        <Series name="GB" values={[355, 65, 48, 103]}/>
      </BarChart>
    </Card>
    <Card title="Documents">
      <Table columns={["Path", "Size"]} rows={[["neoworks", "210 GB"], ["clients", "45 GB"], ["other", "47 GB"]]}/>
    </Card>
    <Card title="Last 6 months" tone="accent">
      <Sparkline values={[610, 655, 700, 742, 790, 820]} label="Used, GB"/>
    </Card>
  </Grid>
</Stack>
```
